name: readme-ai
description: AI-powered README file generator with beautiful templates and structured output

install_guidance.note: Available via PyPI. Supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, and offline mode. Source: https://github.com/eli64s/readme-ai (2.9k+ stars). Written in Python.

commands.description: Generate a README file from a repository URL or local path using AI

args.name: repository
args.description: Repository URL or local directory path

args.name: api
args.description: LLM API provider (openai, anthropic, gemini, ollama, offline)

args.name: output
args.description: Output filename for the generated README

args.name: model
args.description: LLM model to use (e.g. gpt-4, claude-3-5-sonnet)

args.name: badge-color
args.description: Badge color name or hex code

args.name: badge-style
args.description: Badge icon style (flat, flat-square, plastic, for-the-badge)

args.name: header-style
args.description: Header template style (classic, modern, compact, console, banner)

args.name: navigation-style
args.description: Table of contents style (bullet, fold, roman, number, accordion)

args.name: logo
args.description: Project logo (blue, custom, llm, or image path)

args.name: tree-max-depth
args.description: Maximum depth of directory tree in README

args.name: align
args.description: Text alignment in header (center, left, right)
